assertions.text: Classifies the 'Fork PR (unsupported)' context as missing, not pending or failing, since it has no matching statusCheckRollup entry at all
Classifies the 'Python quality' context as pending, since its CheckRun status is IN_PROGRESS
States missing is not the same as pending -- nothing has actually started running for the missing context
Does not report the PR as ready to merge given these two non-passing required contexts
